plan: My private value is $30. In a single-round auction with independent value draw, the optimal strategy is to bid strategically near my true value. Since I want to maximize profit, I'll bid slightly below my true value to create a potential profit margin. A bid around $25-$28 allows me to potentially win if others bid lower, while protecting against overpaying. This balances the risk of losing the item versus winning at a profitable price point.

A bid around $30-$35 seems reasonable - high enough to compete but not so high that I risk significant loss if I win.
